results.title: Smart city plans high-speed digital backbone
results.description: MIRI: Kenyalang Smart City is set to be equipped with high-capacity fibre and 5G infrastructure under a proposed collaboration between SACOFA Sdn Bhd and its master developer, Imasa Dinasti Sdn Bhd. The two companies signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to explore the development of resilient and future-ready telecommunications infrastructure for the integrated development here. [...]
